newsitem.title: CHINA: China province '96 corn output up 19.2 pct.
newsitem.headline: China province '96 corn output up 19.2 pct.

text.p: China's northeastern province of Heilongjiang produced 14.45 million tonnes of corn in 1996, up 19.2 percent from 1995, the China Grains, Oils and Feeds newsletter said in an edition seen in Beijing on Monday.
The province, a major grain supplier, produced 6.36 million tonnes of rice in 1996, up 35.3 percent from 1995, it said. Wheat output hit 3.295 million tonnes in 1996, up 15 percent year-on-year.
Heilongjiang's soybean output reached 4.135 million tonnes in 1996, down 8.5 percent from 1995, the newsletter said.
China's grain output was estimated to have surpassed a record 480 million tonnes in 1996, compared with a previous record of 466 million tonnes in 1995, official media have said.
Rising grain output had depressed domestic prices, the official newsletter said. The national average price of wheat was down 4.6 percent from a year ago as of the end of 1996.
The national average price of corn was down 21.4 percent at the end of 1996 from a year ago and the rice price was 11.91 percent lower, it said.
